notes.title: What's next for Blood Island...
notes.content:
Great news, players!

I've been working hard to bring you a big update! I'm really excited about everything I'm doing with the game!

I've been posting devlogs frequently showing everything that's changing in the game. All new features, improvements and new content. I made a video to show some of the action with new weapons, headshot system, new graphics and much more! This is just the beginning: more updates will come in the future!

[previewyoutube=UtOHeSf92CM;full][/previewyoutube]

List of what has already been improved, for the next version.

New Graphics
I'm making a point of completely overhauling the graphics, so that the island is even more attractive to explore and face all the dangers that exist on it. Scenery, Weapons, Enemies and Cutscenes, all with new looks.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756437/3818221fb35263b0de6035399493d54bbf204f44.png

New Player Animations
New animations added to the player, our character now has different animations for each equipped weapon, some animations have also been refined and even recreated to be more fluid and convincing! A new variation of melee attack animations, now the axe, pickaxe or punch attack is not as repetitive.

New Animations and Enemy Attacks
Of course the enemies weren't left out, new animations and attacks for the stone golem: I'm not working on it yet, but very soon we will also have new enemies arriving on the island!

New Weapons
A new automatic weapon joins the arsenal! A machine gun with a good rate of fire to evaporate your enemies. Grenades are now also part of the arsenal!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41756437/7b05900281b7f288f65db0a187e30e8b08ad1fec.gif

Headshot System
The Rifle and Throwing Spear have received increased damage to the head of enemies, who now take severe damage if hit in the head. The aiming and focusing animation for the rifle makes your aim more accurate.
[previewyoutube=kooAZrHE0Ag;full][/previewyoutube]

Improved Combat
With the arrival of new weapons and enemies, combat could not fail to be improved, now with much more strategic options to defeat enemies, switching between different types of weapons and items.

Improved Crafting System
Additional information on the crafting tab, the total amount of items that will be used for crafting, now appears on the screen, to assist in deciding what to craft.

Field of View
Wider field of view, allowing greater visibility of the player's surroundings.

Add Blood Island to your wishlist!
This update will be a big step forward! So what are you waiting for? Add Blood Island to your wishlist to continue tracking progress and get notified once the update goes live.
